verses.en: How doth the city sit solitary, that was full of people! how is she become as a widow! she that was great among the nations, and princess among the provinces, how is she become tributary!
verses.fr: Eh quoi! elle est assise solitaire, cette ville si peuplée! Elle est semblable à une veuve! Grande entre les nations, souveraine parmi les états, Elle est réduite à la servitude!
verses.am: አሌፍ። ሕዝብ ሞልቶባት የነበረች ከተማ ብቻዋን እንዴት ተቀመጠች! በአሕዛብ መካከል ታላቅ የነበረች እንደ መበለት ሆናለች፤ በአውራጆች መካከል ልዕልት የነበረች ተገዢ ሆናለች።

verses.en: She weepeth sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks: among all her lovers she hath none to comfort her: all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.
verses.fr: Elle pleure durant la nuit, et ses joues sont couvertes de larmes; De tous ceux qui l''aimaient nul ne la console; Tous ses amis lui sont devenus infidèles, Ils sont devenus ses ennemis.
verses.am: ቤት። በሌሊት እጅግ ታላቅሳለች፥ እንባዋም በጕንጭዋ ላይ አለ፤ ከውሽሞችዋ ሁሉ የሚያጽናናት የለም፤ ወዳጆችዋ ሁሉ ወነጀሉአት ጠላቶችም ሆኑአት።

verses.en: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude: she dwelleth among the heathen, she findeth no rest: all her persecutors overtook her between the straits.
verses.fr: Juda est en exil, victime de l''oppression et d''une grande servitude; Il habite au milieu des nations, Et il n''y trouve point de repos; Tous ses persécuteurs l''ont surpris dans l''angoisse.
verses.am: ጋሜል። ይሁዳ ስለ መጨነቅና ስለ ባርነት ብዛት ተማረከች፤ በአሕዛብ መካከል ተቀመጠች ዕረፍትም አላገኘችም፤ የሚያስጨንቁአት ሁሉ ተጨንቃ አገኙአት።

verses.en: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn feasts: all her gates are desolate: her priests sigh, her virgins are afflicted, and she is in bitterness.
verses.fr: Les chemins de Sion sont dans le deuil, car on ne va plus aux fêtes; Toutes ses portes sont désertes, Ses sacrificateurs gémissent, Ses vierges sont affligées, et elle est remplie d''amertume.
verses.am: ዳሌጥ። ወደ ዓመት በዓልም የሚመጣ የለምና የጽዮን መንገዶች አለቀሱ፤ በሮችዋ ሁሉ ፈርሰዋል ካህናቶችዋም እየጮኹ ያለቅሳሉ፤ ደናግሎችዋም ተጨነቁ እርስዋም በምሬት አለች።

verses.en: Her adversaries are the chief, her enemies prosper; for the Lord hath afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: her children are gone into captivity before the enemy.
verses.fr: Ses oppresseurs triomphent, ses ennemis sont en paix; Car l''Eternel l''a humiliée, A cause de la multitude de ses péchés; Ses enfants ont marché captifs devant l''oppresseur.
verses.am: ሄ። ስለ ኃጢአትዋ ብዛት እግዚአብሔር አስጨንቆአታልና አስጨናቂዎችዋ ራስ ሆኑ ጠላቶችዋም ተከናወነላቸው፤ ሕፃናቶችዋ በአስጨናቂዎች ፊት ተማርከዋል።

verses.en: And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty is departed: her princes are become like harts that find no pasture, and they are gone without strength before the pursuer.
verses.fr: La fille de Sion a perdu toute sa gloire; Ses chefs sont comme des cerfs Qui ne trouvent point de pâture, Et qui fuient sans force devant celui qui les chasse.
verses.am: ዋው። ከጽዮን ሴት ልጅ ውበትዋ ሁሉ ወጥቶአል፤ አለቆችዋ ማሰማርያ እንደማያገኙ ዋላዎች ሆኑ፤ ከሚያባርሩአቸው ፊት ተዳክመው ሄዱ።

verses.en: Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that she had in the days of old, when her people fell into the hand of the enemy, and none did help her: the adversaries saw her, and did mock at her sabbaths.
verses.fr: Aux jours de sa détresse et de sa misère, Jérusalem s''est souvenue De tous les biens dès longtemps son partage, Quand son peuple est tombé sans secours sous la main de l''oppresseur; Ses ennemis l''ont vue, et ils ont ri de sa chute.
verses.am: ዛይ። ኢየሩሳሌም በጭንቀትዋና በመከራዋ ወራት ከጥንት ጀምሮ የነበረላትን የከበረን ነገር ሁሉ አሰበች፤ ሕዝብዋ በአስጨናቂዎች እጅ በወደቀ ጊዜ የሚረዳትም በሌላት ጊዜ፥ አስጨናቂዎች አዩአት በመፍረስዋም ሳቁ።

verses.en: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned; therefore she is removed: all that honoured her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yea, she sigheth, and turneth backward.
verses.fr: Jérusalem a multiplié ses péchés, C''est pourquoi elle est un objet d''aversion; Tous ceux qui l''honoraient la méprisent, en voyant sa nudité; Elle-même soupire, et détourne la face.
verses.am: ሔት። ኢየሩሳሌም እጅግ ኃጢአት ሠርታለች፤ ስለዚህ ረክሳለች፤ ያከብሩአት የነበሩ ሁሉ ኀፍረተ ሥጋዋን አይተዋታልና አቃለሉአት፤ እርስዋም እየጮኸች ታለቅሳለች ወደ ኋላም ዘወር አለች።

verses.en: Her filthiness is in her skirts; she remembereth not her last end; therefore she came down wonderfully: she had no comforter. O Lord, behold my affliction: for the enemy hath magnified himself.
verses.fr: La souillure était dans les pans de sa robe, et elle ne songeait pas à sa fin; Elle est tombée d''une manière étonnante, et nul ne la console. -Vois ma misère, ô Eternel! Quelle arrogance chez l''ennemi! -
verses.am: ጤት። አደፍዋ በልብስዋ ዘርፍ ነበረ፤ ፍጻሜዋን አላሰበችም፤ ስለዚህ በድንቅ ተዋርዳለች፥ የሚያጽናናትም የለም፤ አቤቱ፥ ጠላት ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና መከራዬን ተመልከት።

verses.en: The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: for she hath seen that the heathen entered into her sanctuary, whom thou didst command that they should not enter into thy congregation.
verses.fr: L''oppresseur a étendu la main Sur tout ce qu''elle avait de précieux; Elle a vu pénétrer dans son sanctuaire les nations Auxquelles tu avais défendu d''entrer dans ton assemblée.
verses.am: ዮድ። አስጨናቂው በከበረ ነገርዋ ሁሉ ላይ እጁን ዘረጋ፤ ወደ ጉባኤህ እንዳይገቡ ያዘዝሃቸው አሕዛብ ወደ መቅደስዋ ሲገቡ አይታለችና።

verses.en: All her people sigh, they seek bread; they have given their pleasant things for meat to relieve the soul: see, O Lord, and consider; for I am become vile.
verses.fr: Tout son peuple soupire, il cherche du pain; Ils ont donné leurs choses précieuses pour de la nourriture, Afin de ranimer leur vie. -Vois, Eternel, regarde comme je suis avilie!
verses.am: ካፍ። ሕዝብዋ ሁሉ እየጮኹ ያለቅሳሉ እንጀራም ይፈልጋሉ፤ ሰውነታቸውን ለማበርታት የከበረ ሀብታቸውን ስለ መብል ሰጥተዋል፤ አቤቱ፥ ተጐሳቍያለሁና እይ፥ ተመልከትም።

verses.en: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the Lord hath afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.
verses.fr: Je m''adresse à vous, à vous tous qui passez ici! Regardez et voyez s''il est une douleur pareille à ma douleur, A celle dont j''ai été frappée! L''Eternel m''a affligée au jour de son ardente colère.
verses.am: ላሜድ። እናንተ መንገድ አላፊዎች ሁሉ፥ በእናንተ ዘንድ ምንም የለምን? እግዚአብሔር በጽኑ ቍጣው ቀን እኔን እንዳስጨነቀበት በእኔ ላይ እንደ ተደረገው እንደ እኔ መከራ የሚመስል መከራ እንዳለ ተመልከቱ፥ እዩ።

verses.en: From above hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them: he hath spread a net for my feet, he hath turned me back: he hath made me desolate and faint all the day.
verses.fr: D''en haut il a lancé dans mes os un feu qui les dévore; Il a tendu un filet sous mes pieds, Il m''a fait tomber en arrière; Il m''a jetée dans la désolation, dans une langueur de tous les jours.
verses.am: ሜም። ከላይ እሳትን ወደ አጥንቴ ሰደደ በረታችበትም፤ ለእግሬ ወጥመድ ዘረጋ ወደ ኋላም መለሰኝ፥ አጠፋኝም ቀኑንም ሁሉ አደከመኝ።

verses.en: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: they are wreathed, and come up upon my neck: he hath made my strength to fall, the Lord hath delivered me into their hands, from whom I am not able to rise up.
verses.fr: Sa main a lié le joug de mes iniquités; Elles se sont entrelacées, appliquées sur mon cou; Il a brisé ma force; Le Seigneur m''a livrée à des mains auxquelles je ne puis résister.
verses.am: ኖን። የኃጢአቶቼ ቀንበር በእጁ ተይዛለች፤ ታስረው በአንገቴ ላይ ወጥተዋል፤ ጕልበቴን አደከመ። ጌታ በፊታቸው እቆም ዘንድ በማልችላቸው እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጠኝ።

verses.en: The Lord hath trodden under foot all my mighty men in the midst of me: he hath called an assembly against me to crush my young men: the Lord hath trodden the virgin, the daughter of Judah, as in a winepress.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur a terrassé tous mes guerriers au milieu de moi; Il a rassemblé contre moi une armée, Pour détruire mes jeunes hommes; Le Seigneur a foulé au pressoir la vierge, fille de Juda.
verses.am: ሳምኬት። ጌታ ኃያላኖቼን ሁሉ ከውስጤ አስወገዳቸው፤ ጕልማሶቼን ያደቅቅ ዘንድ ጉባኤን ጠራብኝ፤ ጌታ ድንግሊቱን የይሁዳን ልጅ በመጥመቂያ እንደሚረገጥ አድርጎ ረገጣት።

verses.en: For these things I weep; mine eye, mine eye runneth down with water, because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: my children are desolate, because the enemy prevailed.
verses.fr: C''est pour cela que je pleure, que mes yeux fondent en larmes; Car il s''est éloigné de moi, celui qui me consolerait, Qui ranimerait ma vie. Mes fils sont dans la désolation, parce que l''ennemi a triomphé. -
verses.am: ዔ። የሚያጽናናኝ ነፍሴንም የሚያበረታት ከእኔ ርቆአልና ስለዚህ አለቅሳለሁ፤ ዓይኔ፥ ዓይኔ ውኃ ያፈስሳል። ጠላት በርትቶአልና ልጆቼ ጠፍተዋል።

verses.en: Zion spreadeth forth her hands, and there is none to comfort her: the Lord hath commanded concerning Jacob, that his adversaries should be round about him: Jerusalem is as a menstruous woman among them.
verses.fr: Sion a étendu les mains, Et personne ne l''a consolée; L''Eternel a envoyé contre Jacob les ennemis d''alentour; Jérusalem a été un objet d''horreur au milieu d''eux. -
verses.am: ፌ። ጽዮን እጅዋን ዘረጋች፤ የሚያጽናናት የለም፤ እግዚአብሔር በያዕቆብ ዙሪያ ያሉትን እንዲያስጨንቁት አዘዘ፤ ኢየሩሳሌም በመካከላቸው እንደ ርኩስ ነገር ሆናለች።

verses.en: The Lord is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est juste, Car j''ai été rebelle à ses ordres. Ecoutez, vous tous, peuples, et voyez ma douleur! Mes vierges et mes jeunes hommes sont allés en captivité.
verses.am: ጻዴ። በአፉ ነገር ላይ ዓመፅ አድርጌአለሁና እግዚአብሔር ጻድቅ ነው። እናንተ አሕዛብ ሁሉ፥ እባካችሁ፥ ስሙ መከራዬንም ተመልከቱ፤ ደናግሎቼና ጐበዛዝቴ ተማርከው ሄዱ።

verses.en: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me: my priests and mine elders gave up the ghost in the city, while they sought their meat to relieve their souls.
verses.fr: J''ai appelé mes amis, et ils m''ont trompée. Mes sacrificateurs et mes anciens ont expiré dans la ville: Ils cherchaient de la nourriture, Afin de ranimer leur vie.
verses.am: ቆፍ። ውሽሞቼን ጠራሁ እነርሱም አታለሉኝ፤ ካህናቶቼና ሽማግሌዎቼ ሰውነታቸውን ያበረቱ ዘንድ መብል ሲፈልጉ በከተማ ውስጥ ሞቱ።

verses.en: Behold, O Lord; for I am in distress: my bowels are troubled; mine heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: abroad the sword bereaveth, at home there is as death.
verses.fr: Eternel, regarde ma détresse! Mes entrailles bouillonnent, Mon coeur est bouleversé au dedans de moi, Car j''ai été rebelle. Au dehors l''épée a fait ses ravages, au dedans la mort.
verses.am: ሬስ። አቤቱ፥ ተጨንቄአለሁና፥ አንጀቴም ታውኮብኛልና ተመልከት፤ ዓመፃን ፈጽሞ አድርጌአለሁና ልቤ በውስጤ ተገላበጠብኝ፤ በሜዳ ሰይፍ ልጆቼን አጠፋ በቤትም ሞት አለ።

verses.en: They have heard that I sigh: there is none to comfort me: all mine enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that thou hast done it: thou wilt bring the day that thou hast called, and they shall be like unto me.
verses.fr: On a entendu mes soupirs, et personne ne m''a consolée; Tous mes ennemis ont appris mon malheur, Ils se sont réjouis de ce que tu l''as causé; Tu amèneras, tu publieras le jour où ils seront comme moi.
verses.am: ሳን። እኔ እየጮኽሁ እንደማለቅስ ሰምተዋል፤ የሚያጽናናኝ የለም፤ ጠላቶቼ ሁሉ ስለ መከራዬ ሰምተዋል፤ አንተ አድርገኸዋልና ደስ አላቸው፤ ስለ እርሱ የተናገርኸውን ቀን ታመጣለህ እነርሱም እንደ እኔ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: Let all their wickedness come before thee; and do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions: for my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.
verses.fr: Que toute leur méchanceté vienne devant toi, Et traite-les comme tu m''as traitée, A cause de toutes mes transgressions! Car mes soupirs sont nombreux, et mon coeur est souffrant.
verses.am: ታው። ልቅሶዬ እጅግ ነውና፥ ልቤም ደክሞአልና ክፋታቸው ሁሉ ወደ ፊትህ ይድረስ፥ ስለ ኃጢአቴ ሁሉ እንዳደረግህብኝ አድርግባቸው።

verses.en: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel, and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!
verses.fr: Eh quoi! le Seigneur, dans sa colère, a couvert de nuages la fille de Sion! Il a précipité du ciel sur la terre la magnificence d''Israël! Il ne s''est pas souvenu de son marchepied, Au jour de sa colère!
verses.am: አሌፍ። ጌታ በቍጣው የጽዮንን ሴት ልጅ እንደ ምን አደመናት! የእስራኤልን ውበት ከሰማይ ወደ ምድር ጣለ፥ በቍጣውም ቀን የእግሩን መረገጫ አላሰበም።

verses.en: The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and hath not pitied: he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah; he hath brought them down to the ground: he hath polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur a détruit sans pitié toutes les demeures de Jacob; Il a, dans sa fureur, renversé les forteresses de la fille de Juda, Il les a fait rouler à terre; Il a profané le royaume et ses chefs.
verses.am: ቤት። ጌታ የያዕቆብን ማደሪያዎች ሁሉ ዋጠ፥ አልራራምም፤ በመዓቱ የይሁዳን ሴት ልጅ አምቦች አፈረሰ፥ ወደ ምድርም አወረዳቸው፤ መንግሥቱንና አለቆችዋን አረከሰ።

verses.en: He hath cut off in his fierce anger all the horn of Israel: he hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy, and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire, which devoureth round about.
verses.fr: Il a, dans son ardente colère, abattu toute la force d''Israël; Il a retiré sa droite en présence de l''ennemi; Il a allumé dans Jacob des flammes de feu, Qui dévorent de tous côtés.
verses.am: ጋሜል። በጽኑ ቍጣው የእስራኤልን ቀንድ ሁሉ ቀጠቀጠ፤ ቀኝ እጁን ከጠላት ፊት ወደ ኋላ መለሰ፥ በዙሪያውም እንደሚባላ እንደ እሳት ነበልባል ያዕቆብን አቃጠለ።

verses.en: He hath bent his bow like an enemy: he stood with his right hand as an adversary, and slew all that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion: he poured out his fury like fire.
verses.fr: Il a tendu son arc comme un ennemi; Sa droite s''est dressée comme celle d''un assaillant; Il a fait périr tout ce qui plaisait aux regards; Il a répandu sa fureur comme un feu sur la tente de la fille de Sion.
verses.am: ዳሌጥ። ቀስቱን እንደ ጠላት ገተረ፥ እንደ አስጨናቂ ቀኝ እጁን አጸና፥ ለዓይንም የሚያምረውን ሁሉ ገደለ፤ በጽዮን ሴት ልጅ ድንኳን መዓቱን እንደ እሳት አፈሰሰ።

verses.en: The Lord was as an enemy: he hath swallowed up Israel, he hath swallowed up all her palaces: he hath destroyed his strong holds, and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur a été comme un ennemi; Il a dévoré Israël, il a dévoré tous ses palais, Il a détruit ses forteresses; Il a rempli la fille de Juda de plaintes et de gémissements.
verses.am: ሄ። ጌታ እንደ ጠላት ሆነ፥ እስራኤልን ዋጠ፤ አዳራሾችዋን ሁሉ ዋጠ፥ አምቦችዋን አጠፋ፤ በይሁዳም ሴት ልጅ ኀዘንና ልቅሶ አበዛ።

verses.en: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden: he hath destroyed his places of the assembly: the Lord hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.
verses.fr: Il a dévasté sa tente comme un jardin, Il a détruit le lieu de son assemblée; L''Eternel a fait oublier en Sion les fêtes et le sabbat, Et, dans sa violente colère, il a rejeté le roi et le sacrificateur.
verses.am: ዋው። ማደሪያውን እንደ አትክልት ነቀለ፤ የበዓሉን ስፍራ አጠፋ፤ እግዚአብሔር በጽዮን ዓመት በዓሉንና ሰንበቱን አስረሳ፥ በቍጣውም መዓት ንጉሡንና ካህኑን አቃለለ።

verses.en: The Lord hath cast off his altar, he hath abhorred his sanctuary, he hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; they have made a noise in the house of the Lord, as in the day of a solemn feast.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur a dédaigné son autel, repoussé son sanctuaire; Il a livré entre les mains de l''ennemi les murs des palais de Sion; Les cris ont retenti dans la maison de l''Eternel, Comme en un jour de fête.
verses.am: ዛይ። ጌታ መሠዊያውን ጣለ፥ መቅደሱን ጠላ፥ የአዳራሾችዋንም ቅጥር በጠላት እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጠ፤ ድምፃቸውን እንደ ዓመት በዓል ቀን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ከፍ ከፍ አደረጉ።

verses.en: The Lord hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he hath stretched out a line, he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying: therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament; they languished together.
verses.fr: L''Eternel avait résolu de détruire les murs de la fille de Sion; Il a tendu le cordeau, il n''a pas retiré sa main sans les avoir anéantis; Il a plongé dans le deuil rempart et murailles, Qui n''offrent plus ensemble qu''une triste ruine.
verses.am: ሔት። እግዚአብሔር የጽዮንን ሴት ልጅ ቅጥር ያፈርስ ዘንድ አሰበ፤ የመለኪያውን ገመድ ዘረጋ፥ እጁን ከማጥፋት አልመለሰም፤ ምሽጉና ቅጥሩ እንዲያለቅሱ አደረገ፤ በአንድነት ደከሙ።

verses.en: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he hath destroyed and broken her bars: her king and her princes are among the Gentiles: the law is no more; her prophets also find no vision from the Lord.
verses.fr: Ses portes sont enfoncées dans la terre; Il en a détruit, rompu les barres. Son roi et ses chefs sont parmi les nations; il n''y a plus de loi. Même les prophètes ne reçoivent aucune vision de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ጤት። በሮችዋ በመሬት ውስጥ ሰጠሙ፥ መወርወሪያዎችዋን አጠፋ ሰበረም፤ ንጉሥዋና አለቆችዋ ሕግ በሌለባቸው በአሕዛብ መካከል አሉ፤ ነቢያቶቻዋም ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ራእይ አላገኙም።

verses.en: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, and keep silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.
verses.fr: Les anciens de la fille de Sion sont assis à terre, ils sont muets; Ils ont couvert leur tête de poussière, Ils se sont revêtus de sacs; Les vierges de Jérusalem laissent retomber leur tête vers la terre.
verses.am: ዮድ። የጽዮን ሴት ልጅ ሽማግሌዎች ዝም ብለው በመሬት ላይ ተቀምጠዋል፤ ትቢያን በራሳቸው ላይ ነሰነሱ፥ ማቅም ታጠቁ፤ የኢየሩሳሌም ደናግል ራሳቸውን ወደ ምድር አዘነበሉ።

verses.en: Mine eyes do fail with tears, my bowels are troubled, my liver is poured upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.
verses.fr: Mes yeux se consument dans les larmes, mes entrailles bouillonnent, Ma bile se répand sur la terre, A cause du désastre de la fille de mon peuple, Des enfants et des nourrissons en défaillance dans les rues de la ville.
verses.am: ካፍ። ሕፃኑና ጡት የሚጠባው በከተማይቱ ጐዳና ላይ ሲዝሉ፥ ዓይኔ በእንባ ደከመች፥ አንጀቴም ታወከ፤ ስለ ወገኔ ሴት ልጅ ቅጥቃጤ ጉበቴ በምድር ላይ ተዘረገፈ።

verses.en: They say to their mothers, Where is corn and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers' bosom.
verses.fr: Ils disaient à leurs mères: Où y a-t-il du blé et du vin? Et ils tombaient comme des blessés dans les rues de la ville, Ils rendaient l''âme sur le sein de leurs mères.
verses.am: ላሜድ። በከተማ ጐዳና እንደ ተወጋ ሰው በዛሉ ጊዜ፥ ነፍሳቸውም በእናቶቻቸው ብብት በወጣች ጊዜ፥ እናቶቻቸውን። እህልና የወይን ጠጅ ወዴት አለ? ይሉአቸዋል።

verses.en: What thing shall I take to witness for thee? what thing shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? what shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion? for thy breach is great like the sea: who can heal thee?
verses.fr: Que dois-je te dire? à quoi te comparer, fille de Jérusalem? Qui trouver de semblable à toi, et quelle consolation te donner, Vierge, fille de Sion? Car ta plaie est grande comme la mer: qui pourra te guérir?
verses.am: ሜም። የኢየሩሳሌም ሴት ልጅ ሆይ፥ ምን እመሰክርልሻለሁ? በምንስ እመስልሻለሁ? ድንግሊቱ የጽዮን ልጅ ሆይ፥ አጽናናሽ ዘንድ በምን አስተካክልሻለሁ? ስብራትሽ እንደ ባሕር ታላቅ ነውና፤ የሚፈውስሽ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Thy prophets have seen vain and foolish things for thee: and they have not discovered thine iniquity, to turn away thy captivity; but have seen for thee false burdens and causes of banishment.
verses.fr: Tes prophètes ont eu pour toi des visions vaines et fausses; Ils n''ont pas mis à nu ton iniquité, Afin de détourner de toi la captivité; Ils t''ont donné des oracles mensongers et trompeurs.
verses.am: ኖን። ነቢያቶችሽ ከንቱና ሐሰተኛ ራእይ አይተውልሻል፤ ምርኮሽንም ይመልሱ ዘንድ በደልሽን አልገለጡም፤ ከንቱና የማይረባ ነገርንም አይተውልሻል።

verses.en: All that pass by clap their hands at thee; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, Is this the city that men call The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?
verses.fr: Tous les passants battent des mains sur toi, Ils sifflent, ils secouent la tête contre la fille de Jérusalem: Est-ce là cette ville qu''on appelait une beauté parfaite, La joie de toute la terre?
verses.am: ሳምኬት። መንገድ አላፊዎች ሁሉ እጃቸውን ያጨበጭቡብሻልና። በውኑ የውበት ፍጻሜና የምድር ሁሉ ደስታ የሚሉአት ከተማ ይህች ናትን? እያሉ፥ በኢየሩሳሌም ሴት ልጅ ላይ ያፍዋጫሉ፥ ራሳቸውንም ያነቃንቃሉ።

verses.en: All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee: they hiss and gnash the teeth: they say, We have swallowed her up: certainly this is the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen it.
verses.fr: Tous tes ennemis ouvrent la bouche contre toi, Ils sifflent, ils grincent des dents, Ils disent: Nous l''avons engloutie! C''est bien le jour que nous attendions, nous l''avons atteint, nous le voyons!
verses.am: ዔ። ጠላቶችሽ ሁሉ አፋቸውን አላቀቁብሽ፤ እያፍዋጩና ጥርሳቸውን እያፋጩ። ውጠናታል፤ ነገር ግን ተስፋ ያደረግናት ቀን ይህች ናት፤ አግኝተናታል አይተናትማል ይላሉ።

verses.en: The Lord hath done that which he had devised; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old: he hath thrown down, and hath not pitied: and he hath caused thine enemy to rejoice over thee, he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries.
verses.fr: L''Eternel a exécuté ce qu''il avait résolu, Il a accompli la parole qu''il avait dès longtemps arrêtée, Il a détruit sans pitié; Il a fait de toi la joie de l''ennemi, Il a relevé la force de tes oppresseurs.
verses.am: ፌ። እግዚአብሔር ያሰበውን አደረገ፤ በቀድሞ ዘመን ያዘዘውን ቃል ፈጸመ፤ አፈረሰ አልራራምም፤ ጠላትንም ደስ አሰኘብሽ፥ የሚያስጨንቁሽንም ቀንድ ከፍ ከፍ አደረገ።

verses.en: Their heart cried unto the Lord, O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night: give thyself no rest; let not the apple of thine eye cease.
verses.fr: Leur coeur crie vers le Seigneur... Mur de la fille de Sion, répands jour et nuit des torrents de larmes! Ne te donne aucun relâche, Et que ton oeil n''ait point de repos!
verses.am: ጻዴ። ልባቸው ወደ ጌታ ጮኸ። የጽዮን ሴት ልጅ ቅጥር ሆይ፥ እንባሽን እንደ ፈሳሽ ቀንና ሌሊት አፍስሺ፤ ለሰውነትሽ ዕረፍት አትስጪ፤ የዓይንሽ ብሌን አታቋርጥ።

verses.en: Arise, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before the face of the Lord: lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children, that faint for hunger in the top of every street.
verses.fr: Lève-toi, pousse des gémissements à l''entrée des veilles de la nuit! Répands ton coeur comme de l''eau, en présence du Seigneur! Lève tes mains vers lui pour la vie de tes enfants Qui meurent de faim aux coins de toutes les rues!
verses.am: ቆፍ። ተነሺ፥ በሌሊት በመጀመሪያ ክፍል ጩኺ፥ በጌታም ፊት ልብሽን እንደ ውኃ አፍስሺ፤ በጐዳና ሁሉ ራስ ላይ በራብ ስለ ደከሙ ስለ ሕፃናትሽ ነፍስ እጆችሽን ወደ እርሱ አንሺ።

verses.en: Behold, O Lord, and consider to whom thou hast done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, and children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?
verses.fr: Vois, Eternel, regarde qui tu as ainsi traité! Fallait-il que des femmes dévorassent le fruit de leurs entrailles, Les petits enfants objets de leur tendresse? Que sacrificateurs et prophètes fussent massacrés dans le sanctuaire du Seigneur?
verses.am: ሬስ። አቤቱ፥ እይ፤ በማን ላይ እንደዚህ እንዳደረግህ ተመልከት። በውኑ ሴቶች ፍሬያቸውን፥ ያቀማጠሉአቸውን ሕፃናት፥ ይበላሉን? በውኑ ካህኑና ነቢዩ በጌታ መቅደስ ውስጥ ይገደላሉን?

verses.en: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets: my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword; thou hast slain them in the day of thine anger; thou hast killed, and not pitied.
verses.fr: Les enfants et les vieillards sont couchés par terre dans les rues; Mes vierges et mes jeunes hommes sont tombés par l''épée; Tu as tué, au jour de ta colère, Tu as égorgé sans pitié.
verses.am: ሳን። ብላቴናውና ሽማግሌው በመንገዶች ላይ ተጋደሙ፤ ደናግሎቼና ጐበዛዝቴ በሰይፍ ወድቀዋል፤ በቍጣህ ቀን ገደልሃቸው፤ ሳትራራ አረድሃቸው።

verses.en: Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors round about, so that in the day of the Lord's anger none escaped nor remained: those that I have swaddled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed.
verses.fr: Tu as appelé de toutes parts sur moi l''épouvante, comme à un jour de fête. Au jour de la colère de l''Eternel, il n''y a eu ni réchappé ni survivant. Ceux que j''avais soignés et élevés, Mon ennemi les a consumés.
verses.am: ታው። እንደ በዓል ቀን የሚያስፈሩኝን ከዙሪያዬ ጠራህ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ ቀንም ያመለጠ ወይም የቀረ አልተገኘም፤ ያቀማጠልኋቸውንና ያሳደግኋቸውን ጠላቴ በላቸው።

verses.en: I Am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
verses.fr: Je suis l''homme qui a vu la misère Sous la verge de sa fureur.
verses.am: አሌፍ። በቍጣው በትር መከራ ያየ ሰው እኔ ነኝ።

verses.en: He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.
verses.fr: Il m''a conduit, mené dans les ténèbres, Et non dans la lumière.
verses.am: ብርሃን ወደ ሌለበት ወደ ጨለማ መርቶ ወሰደኝ።

verses.en: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day.
verses.fr: Contre moi il tourne et retourne sa main Tout le jour.
verses.am: ዘወትር ቀኑን ሁሉ እጁን በላዬ መለሰ።

verses.en: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.
verses.fr: Il a fait dépérir ma chair et ma peau, Il a brisé mes os.
verses.am: ቤት። ሥጋዬንና ቁርበቴን አስረጀ፥ አጥንቴን ሰበረ።

verses.en: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.
verses.fr: Il a bâti autour de moi, Il m''a environné de poison et de douleur.
verses.am: ቅጥር ሠራብኝ በሐሞትና በድካምም ከበበኝ።

verses.en: He hath set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.
verses.fr: Il me fait habiter dans les ténèbres, Comme ceux qui sont morts dès longtemps.
verses.am: ቀድሞ ሞተው እንደ ነበሩ በጨለማ አኖረኝ።

verses.en: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.
verses.fr: Il m''a entouré d''un mur, pour que je ne sorte pas; Il m''a donné de pesantes chaînes.
verses.am: ጋሜል። እንዳልወጣ በዙሪያዬ ቅጥር ሠራብኝ፤ ሰንሰለቴን አከበደ።

verses.en: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.
verses.fr: J''ai beau crier et implorer du secours, Il ne laisse pas accès à ma prière.
verses.am: በጠራሁና በጮኽሁ ጊዜ ጸሎቴን ከለከለ።

verses.en: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.
verses.fr: Il a fermé mon chemin avec des pierres de taille, Il a détruit mes sentiers.
verses.am: መንገዴን በተጠረበ ድንጋይ ዘጋ፥ ጐዳናዬንም አጣመመ።

verses.en: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.
verses.fr: Il a été pour moi un ours en embuscade, Un lion dans un lieu caché.
verses.am: ዳሌጥ። እንደሚሸምቅ ድብ እንደ ተሸሸገም አንበሳ ሆነብኝ።

verses.en: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.
verses.fr: Il a détourné mes voies, il m''a déchiré, Il m''a jeté dans la désolation.
verses.am: መንገዴን ለወጠ፥ ገነጣጠለኝም፤ ባድማ አደረገኝ።

verses.en: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
verses.fr: Il a tendu son arc, et il m''a placé Comme un but pour sa flèche.
verses.am: ቀስቱን ገተረ ለፍላጻውም እንደ ጊጤ አደረገኝ።

verses.en: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.
verses.fr: Il a fait entrer dans mes reins Les traits de son carquois.
verses.am: ሄ። የሰገባውን ፍላጻዎች በኵላሊቴ ውስጥ ተከለ።

verses.en: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.
verses.fr: Je suis pour tout mon peuple un objet de raillerie, Chaque jour l''objet de leurs chansons.
verses.am: ለወገኔ ሁሉ ማላገጫ ቀኑንም ሁሉ መሳለቂያ ሆንሁ።

verses.en: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.
verses.fr: Il m''a rassasié d''amertume, Il m''a enivré d''absinthe.
verses.am: ምሬት ሞላብኝ በእሬትም አጠገበኝ።

verses.en: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.
verses.fr: Il a brisé mes dents avec des cailloux, Il m''a couvert de cendre.
verses.am: ዋው። ጥርሴን በጭንጫ ሰበረ፥ በአመድም ከደነኝ።

verses.en: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.
verses.fr: Tu m''as enlevé la paix; Je ne connais plus le bonheur.
verses.am: ነፍሴን ከሰላም አራቅህ፤ በጎ ነገርን ረሳሁ።

verses.en: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the Lord:
verses.fr: Et j''ai dit: Ma force est perdue, Je n''ai plus d''espérance en l''Eternel!
verses.am: እኔም። ኃይሌ ከእግዚአብሔርም ዘንድ ያለው ተስፋዬ ጠፋ አልሁ።

verses.en: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.
verses.fr: Quand je pense à ma détresse et à ma misère, A l''absinthe et au poison;
verses.am: ዛይ። መከራዬንና ችግሬን እሬትንና ሐሞትን አስብ።

verses.en: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.
verses.fr: Quand mon âme s''en souvient, Elle est abattue au dedans de moi.
verses.am: ነፍሴ እያሰበችው በውስጤ ፈዘዘች።

verses.en: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.
verses.fr: Voici ce que je veux repasser en mon coeur, Ce qui me donnera de l''espérance.
verses.am: ይህችን በልቤ አኖራለሁ፥ ስለዚህ እታገሣለሁ።

verses.en: It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
verses.fr: Les bontés de l''Eternel ne sont pas épuisées, Ses compassions ne sont pas à leur terme;
verses.am: ሔት። ያልጠፋነው ከእግዚአብሔር ምሕረት የተነሣ ነው፤ ርኅራኄው አያልቅምና።

verses.en: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
verses.fr: Elles se renouvellent chaque matin. Oh! que ta fidélité est grande!
verses.am: ማለዳ ማለዳ አዲስ ነው፤ ታማኝነትህ ብዙ ነው።

verses.en: The Lord is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est mon partage, dit mon âme; C''est pourquoi je veux espérer en lui.
verses.am: ነፍሴ። እግዚአብሔር እድል ፈንታዬ ነው፤ ስለዚህ ተስፋ አደርገዋለሁ አለች።

verses.en: The Lord is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
verses.fr: L''Eternel a de la bonté pour qui espère en lui, Pour l''âme qui le cherche.
verses.am: ጤት። እግዚአብሔር በተስፋ ለሚጠብቁት ለምትሻውም ነፍስ መልካም ነው።

verses.en: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the Lord.
verses.fr: Il est bon d''attendre en silence Le secours de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሰው ዝም ብሎ የእግዚአብሔርን ማዳን ተስፋ ቢያደርግ መልካም ነው።

verses.en: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
verses.fr: Il est bon pour l''homme De porter le joug dans sa jeunesse.
verses.am: ሰው በታናሽነቱ ቀንበር ቢሸከም መልካም ነው።

verses.en: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.
verses.fr: Il se tiendra solitaire et silencieux, Parce que l''Eternel le lui impose;
verses.am: ዮድ። እርሱ አሸክሞታልና ዝም ብሎ ለብቻው ይቀመጥ።

verses.en: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.
verses.fr: Il mettra sa bouche dans la poussière, Sans perdre toute espérance;
verses.am: ተስፋ የሆነው እንደ ሆነ አፉን በአፈር ውስጥ ያኑር።

verses.en: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.
verses.fr: Il présentera la joue à celui qui le frappe, Il se rassasiera d''opprobres.
verses.am: ጕንጩን ለሚመታው ይስጥ፥ ስድብንም ይጥገብ።

verses.en: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:
verses.fr: Car le Seigneur Ne rejette pas à toujours.
verses.am: ካፍ። ጌታ ለዘላለም አይጥልምና፤

verses.en: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.
verses.fr: Mais, lorsqu''il afflige, Il a compassion selon sa grande miséricorde;
verses.am: ቢያሳዝንም እንደ ምሕረቱ ብዛት ይራራልና፤

verses.en: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.
verses.fr: Car ce n''est pas volontiers qu''il humilie Et qu''il afflige les enfants des hommes.
verses.am: የሰውን ልጆች ከልቡ አያስጨንቅም፥ አያሳዝንምም።

verses.en: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth.
verses.fr: Quand on foule aux pieds Tous les captifs du pays,
verses.am: ላሜድ። በምድር የተጋዙትን ሁሉ ከእግሩ በታች ይረግጣቸው ዘንድ፥

verses.en: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,
verses.fr: Quand on viole la justice humaine A la face du Très-Haut,
verses.am: የሰውን ፍርድ በልዑል ፊት ይመልስ ዘንድ፥

verses.en: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.
verses.fr: Quand on fait tort à autrui dans sa cause, Le Seigneur ne le voit-il pas?
verses.am: የሰውን ፍርድ ያጣምም ዘንድ ጌታ እሺ አይልም።

verses.en: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?
verses.fr: Qui dira qu''une chose arrive, Sans que le Seigneur l''ait ordonnée?
verses.am: ሜም። ጌታ ያላዘዘውን የሚልና የሚፈጽም ማን ነው?

verses.en: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?
verses.fr: N''est-ce pas de la volonté du Très-Haut que viennent Les maux et les biens?
verses.am: ከልዑል አፍ ክፉና መልካም ነገር አይወጣምን?

verses.en: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
verses.fr: Pourquoi l''homme vivant se plaindrait-il? Que chacun se plaigne de ses propres péchés.
verses.am: ሕያው ሰው የሚያጕረመርም፥ ሰው ስለ ኃጢአቱ ቅጣት የሚያጕረመርም ስለ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the Lord.
verses.fr: Recherchons nos voies et sondons, Et retournons à l''Eternel;
verses.am: ኖን። መንገዳችንን እንመርምርና እንፈትን፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም እንመለስ።

verses.en: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.
verses.fr: Elevons nos coeurs et nos mains Vers Dieu qui est au ciel:
verses.am: ልባችንን ከእጃችን ጋር በሰማይ ወዳለው ወደ እግዚአብሔር እናንሣ።

verses.en: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.
verses.fr: Nous avons péché, nous avons été rebelles! Tu n''as point pardonné!
verses.am: በድለናል ዐምፀናልም፥ አንተም ይቅር አላልህም።

verses.en: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.
verses.fr: Tu t''es caché dans ta colère, et tu nous as poursuivis; Tu as tué sans miséricorde;
verses.am: ሳምኬት። በቍጣ ከደንኸን አሳደድኸንም፤ ገደልኸን፥ አልራራህም።

verses.en: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.
verses.fr: Tu t''es enveloppé d''un nuage, Pour fermer accès à la prière.
verses.am: ጸሎት እንዳያልፍ ራስህን በደመና ከደንህ።

verses.en: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.
verses.fr: Tu nous as rendus un objet de mépris et de dédain Au milieu des peuples.
verses.am: በአሕዛብ መካከል ጕድፍና ውዳቂ አደረግኸን።

verses.en: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.
verses.fr: Ils ouvrent la bouche contre nous, Tous ceux qui sont nos ennemis.
verses.am: ዔ። ጠላቶቻችን ሁሉ አፋቸውን ኣላቀቁብን።

verses.en: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.
verses.fr: Notre partage a été la terreur et la fosse, Le ravage et la ruine.
verses.am: ድንጋጤና ቍጣ፥ ጥፋትና ቅጥቃጤ ሆነብን።

verses.en: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.fr: Des torrents d''eau coulent de mes yeux, A cause de la ruine de la fille de mon peuple.
verses.am: ስለ ወገኔ ሴት ልጅ ቅጥቃጤ ዓይኔ የውኃ ፈሳሽ አፈሰሰች።

verses.en: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission.
verses.fr: Mon oeil fond en larmes, sans repos, Sans relâche,
verses.am: ስለ ከተማዬ ቈነጃጅት ሁሉ ዓይኔ ነፍሴን አሳዘነች።

verses.en: Till the Lord look down, and behold from heaven.
verses.fr: Jusqu''à ce que l''Eternel regarde et voie Du haut des cieux;
verses.am: ስለ ከተማዬ ቈነጃጅት ሁሉ ዓይኔ ነፍሴን አሳዘነች።

verses.en: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.
verses.fr: Mon oeil me fait souffrir, A cause de toutes les filles de ma ville.
verses.am: ጻዴ። በከንቱ ነገር ጠላቶች የሆኑኝ እንደ ወፍ ማደንን አደኑኝ።

verses.en: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.
verses.fr: Ils m''ont donné la chasse comme à un oiseau, Ceux qui sont à tort mes ennemis.
verses.am: ሕይወቴን በጕድጓድ አጠፉ፥ በላዬም ድንጋይ ጣሉ።

verses.en: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.
verses.fr: Ils ont voulu anéantir ma vie dans une fosse, Et ils ont jeté des pierres sur moi.
verses.am: በራሴ ላይ ውኆች ተከነበሉ፤ እኔም። ጠፋሁ ብዬ ነበር።

verses.en: Waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off.
verses.fr: Les eaux ont inondé ma tête; Je disais: Je suis perdu!
verses.am: ቆፍ። አቤቱ፥ በጠለቀ ጕድጓድ ውስጥ ሆኜ ስምህን ጠራሁ።

verses.en: I called upon thy name, O Lord, out of the low dungeon.
verses.fr: J''ai invoqué ton nom, ô Eternel, Du fond de la fosse.
verses.am: ድምፄን ሰማህ፤ ጆሮህን ከልመናዬ አትመልስ።

verses.en: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.
verses.fr: Tu as entendu ma voix: Ne ferme pas l''oreille à mes soupirs, à mes cris!
verses.am: በጠራሁህ ቀን ቀርበህ። አትፍራ አልህ።

verses.en: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.
verses.fr: Au jour où je t''ai invoqué, tu t''es approché, Tu as dit: Ne crains pas!
verses.am: ሬስ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ስለ ነፍሴ ተምዋግተህ ሕይወቴን ተቤዠህ።

verses.en: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.
verses.fr: Seigneur, tu as défendu la cause de mon âme, Tu as racheté ma vie.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጭንቀቴን አይተሃል፥ ፍርዴን ፍረድልኝ።

verses.en: O Lord, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.
verses.fr: Eternel, tu as vu ce qu''on m''a fait souffrir: Rends-moi justice!
verses.am: በቀላቸውን ሁሉና በእኔ ላይ ያለውን አሳባቸውን ሁሉ አየህ።

verses.en: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.
verses.fr: Tu as vu toutes leurs vengeances, Tous leurs complots contre moi.
verses.am: ሳን። አቤቱ፥ ስድባቸውንና በእኔ ላይ ያለውን አሳባቸውን ሁሉ፥

verses.en: Thou hast heard their reproach, O Lord, and all their imaginations against me;
verses.fr: Eternel, tu as entendu leurs outrages, Tous leurs complots contre moi,
verses.am: የተነሡብኝን ሰዎች ከንፈሮች ቀኑንም ሁሉ ያሰቡብኝን አሳባቸውን ሰማህ።

verses.en: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.
verses.fr: Les discours de mes adversaires, et les projets Qu''ils formaient chaque jour contre moi.
verses.am: መቀመጣቸውንና መነሣታቸውን ተመልከት፤ እኔ መሳለቂያቸው ነኝ።

verses.en: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.
verses.fr: Regarde quand ils sont assis et quand ils se lèvent: Je suis l''objet de leurs chansons.
verses.am: ታው። አቤቱ፥ እንደ እጃቸው ሥራ ፍዳቸውን ትከፍላቸዋለህ።

verses.en: Render unto them a recompence, O Lord, according to the work of their hands.
verses.fr: Tu leur donneras un salaire, ô Eternel, Selon l''oeuvre de leurs mains;
verses.am: የልብ ዕውርነትንና እርግማንህን ትሰጣቸዋለህ።

verses.en: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.
verses.fr: Tu les livreras à l''endurcissement de leur coeur, A ta malédiction contre eux;
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በቍጣ ታሳድዳቸዋለህ ከሰማይም በታች ታጠፋቸዋለህ።

verses.en: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the Lord.
verses.fr: Tu les poursuivras dans ta colère, et tu les extermineras De dessous les cieux, ô Eternel!
verses.am: ፤ አቤቱ፥ በቍጣ ታሳድዳቸዋለህ ከሰማይም በታች ታጠፋቸዋለህ።

verses.en: How is the gold become dim! how is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.
verses.fr: Eh quoi! l''or a perdu son éclat! L''or pur est altéré! Les pierres du sanctuaire sont dispersées Aux coins de toutes les rues!
verses.am: አሌፍ። ወርቁ እንዴት ደበሰ! ጥሩው ወርቅ እንዴት ተለወጠ! የመቅደሱ ድንጋዮች በጐዳና ሁሉ ራስ ተበተኑ።

verses.en: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!
verses.fr: Les nobles fils de Sion, Estimés à l''égal de l''or pur, Sont regardés, hélas! comme des vases de terre, Ouvrage des mains du potier!
verses.am: ቤት። ጥሩ ወርቅ የሚመስሉ የከበሩ የጽዮን ልጆች፥ የሸክላ ሠሪ እጅ እንደ ሠራው እንደ ሸክላ ዕቃ እንዴት ተቈጠሩ!

verses.en: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: the daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.
verses.fr: Les chacals mêmes présentent la mamelle, Et allaitent leurs petits; Mais la fille de mon peuple est devenue cruelle Comme les autruches du désert.
verses.am: ጋሜል። ቀበሮች እንኳ ጡቶታቸውን ገልጠው ግልገሎቻቸውን አጠቡ፤ የወገኔ ልጅ ግን እንደ ምድረ በዳ ሰጐን ጨካኝ ሆነች።

verses.en: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread, and no man breaketh it unto them.
verses.fr: La langue du nourrisson s''attache à son palais, Desséchée par la soif; Les enfants demandent du pain, Et personne ne leur en donne.
verses.am: ዳሌጥ። ጡት የሚጠባው የሕፃን ምላስ ከጥም የተነሣ ወደ ትናጋው ተጣበቀ፤ ሕፃናት እንጀራ ለመኑ፥ የሚቈርስላቸውም የለም።

verses.en: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.
verses.fr: Ceux qui se nourrissaient de mets délicats Périssent dans les rues; Ceux qui étaient élevés dans la pourpre Embrassent les fumiers.
verses.am: ሄ። የጣፈጠ ነገር ይበሉ የነበሩ በመንገድ ጠፉ፤ በቀይ ግምጃ ያድጉ የነበሩ የፍግ ክምር አቀፉ።

verses.en: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, that was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands stayed on her.
verses.fr: Le châtiment de la fille de mon peuple est plus grand Que celui de Sodome, Détruite en un instant, Sans que personne ait porté la main sur elle.
verses.am: ዋው። የማንም እጅ ሳይወድቅባት ድንገት ከተገለበጠች ከሰዶም ኃጢአት ይልቅ የወገኔ ሴት ልጅ ኃጢአት በዛች።

verses.en: Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was of sapphire:
verses.fr: Ses princes étaient plus éclatants que la neige, Plus blancs que le lait; Ils avaient le teint plus vermeil que le corail; Leur figure était comme le saphir.
verses.am: ዛይ። አለቆችዋ ከበረዶ ይልቅ ጥሩ፥ ከወተት ይልቅ ነጭ ነበሩ፤ ገላቸው ከቀይ ዕንቍ ይልቅ ቀይ ነበረ፥ መልካቸውም እንደ ሰንፔር ነበረ።

verses.en: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.
verses.fr: Leur aspect est plus sombre que le noir; On ne les reconnaît pas dans les rues; Ils ont la peau collée sur les os, Sèche comme du bois.
verses.am: ሔት። ፊታቸው ከጥቀርሻ ይልቅ ጠቍሮአል፥ በመንገድም አልታወቁም፤ ቁርበታቸው ወደ አጥንታቸው ተጣብቆአል፤ ደርቆአል፤ እንደ እንጨት ሆኖአል።

verses.en: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for want of the fruits of the field.
verses.fr: Ceux qui périssent par l''épée sont plus heureux Que ceux qui périssent par la faim, Qui tombent exténués, Privés du fruit des champs.
verses.am: ጤት። በሰይፍ የሞቱ በራብ ከሞቱት ይሻላሉ፤ እነዚህ የምድርን ፍሬ አጥተው ተወግተውም ቀጥነዋል።

verses.en: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.fr: Les femmes, malgré leur tendresse, Font cuire leurs enfants; Ils leur servent de nourriture, Au milieu du désastre de la fille de mon peuple.
verses.am: ዮድ። የርኅሩኆች ሴቶች እጆች ልጆቻችውን ቀቅለዋል፤ የወገኔ ሴት ልጅ በመቀጥቀጥዋ መብል ሆኑአቸው።

verses.en: The Lord hath accomplished his fury; he hath poured out his fierce anger, and hath kindled a fire in Zion, and it hath devoured the foundations thereof.
verses.fr: L''Eternel a épuisé sa fureur, Il a répandu son ardente colère; Il a allumé dans Sion un feu Qui en dévore les fondements.
verses.am: ካፍ። እግዚአብሔር መዓቱን ፈጽሞአል፥ ጽኑ ቍጣውን አፍስሶአል፤ እሳትን በጽዮን ውስጥ አቃጠለ፥ መሠረትዋንም በላች።

verses.en: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Les rois de la terre n''auraient pas cru, Aucun des habitants du monde n''aurait cru Que l''adversaire, que l''ennemi entrerait Dans les portes de Jérusalem.
verses.am: ላሜድ። የምድር ነገሥታት በዓለምም የሚኖሩ ሁሉ አስጨናቂና ጠላት በኢየሩሳሌም በር እንዲገባ አላመኑም።

verses.en: For the sins of her prophets, and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her,
verses.fr: Voilà le fruit des péchés de ses prophètes, Des iniquités de ses sacrificateurs, Qui ont répandu dans son sein Le sang des justes!
verses.am: ሜም። የጻድቃንን ደም በውስጥዋ ስላፈሰሱ ስለ ነቢያቶችዋ ኃጢአትና ስለ ካህናቶች በደል ነው።

verses.en: They have wandered as blind men in the streets, they have polluted themselves with blood, so that men could not touch their garments.
verses.fr: Ils erraient en aveugles dans les rues, Souillés de sang; On ne pouvait Toucher leurs vêtements.
verses.am: ኖን። ታውረው በመንገድ ላይ ተቅበዘበዙ፤ ልብሳቸው እንዳይዳሰስ በደም ረክሰዋል።

verses.en: They cried unto them, Depart ye; it is unclean; depart, depart, touch not: when they fled away and wandered, they said among the heathen, They shall no more sojourn there.
verses.fr: Eloignez-vous, impurs! leur criait-on, Eloignez-vous, éloignez-vous, ne nous touchez pas! Ils sont en fuite, ils errent çà et là; On dit parmi les nations: Ils n''auront plus leur demeure!
verses.am: ሳምኬት። እናንተ ርኩሳን፥ ራቁ፥ ርቃችሁም ሂዱ፥ አትንኩ ብለው ጮኹባቸው። በሸሹና በተቅበዘበዙ ጊዜ፥ በአሕዛብ መካከል። በዚህ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይኖሩም ተባለ።

verses.en: The anger of the Lord hath divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not the elders.
verses.fr: L''Eternel les a dispersés dans sa colère, Il ne tourne plus les regards vers eux; On n''a eu ni respect pour les sacrificateurs, Ni pitié pour les vieillards.
verses.am: ዔ። የእግዚአብሔር ፊት በተናቸው እርሱም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይመለከታቸውም፤ የካህናቱን ፊት አላፈሩም፥ ሽማግሌዎቹንም አላከበሩም።

verses.en: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.
verses.fr: Nos yeux se consumaient encore, Et nous attendions vainement du secours; Nos regards se portaient avec espérance Vers une nation qui ne nous a pas délivrés.
verses.am: ፌ። ዓይናችን ወደ ከንቱ ረዳታችን ገና ሲመለከት ጠፍቶአል፤ በመቆየታችን ማዳን የማይቻለውን ሕዝብ ጠብቀናል።

verses.en: They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.
verses.fr: On épiait nos pas, Pour nous empêcher d''aller sur nos places; Notre fin s''approchait, nos jours étaient accomplis... Notre fin est arrivée!
verses.am: ጻዴ። በአደባባያችን እንዳንሄድ ፍለጋችንን ተከተሉ፤ ፍጻሜያችን ቀርቦአል፥ ዕድሜያችን አልቆአል፥ ፍጻሜያችን ደርሶአል።

verses.en: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven: they pursued us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.
verses.fr: Nos persécuteurs étaient plus légers Que les aigles du ciel; Ils nous ont poursuivis sur les montagnes, Ils nous ont dressé des embûches dans le désert.
verses.am: ቆፍ። አሳዳጆቻችን ከሰማይ ንስር ይልቅ ፈጣኖች ሆኑ፤ በተራሮች ላይ አሳደዱን፥ በምድረ በዳ ሸመቁብን።

verses.en: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the Lord, was taken in their pits, of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen.
verses.fr: Celui qui nous faisait respirer, l''oint de l''Eternel, A été pris dans leurs fosses, Lui de qui nous disions: Nous vivrons sous son ombre parmi les nations.
verses.am: ሬስ። ስለ እርሱ። በአሕዛብ መካከል በጥላው በሕይወት እንኖራለን ያልነው በእግዚአብሔር የተቀባ፥ የሕይወታችን እስትንፋስ፥ በጕድጓዳቸው ተያዘ።

verses.en: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz; the cup also shall pass through unto thee: thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.
verses.fr: Réjouis-toi, tressaille d''allégresse, fille d''Edom, Habitante du pays d''Uts! Vers toi aussi passera la coupe; Tu t''enivreras, et tu seras mise à nu.
verses.am: ሳን። በዖፅ ምድር የምትኖሪ የኤዶምያስ ልጅ ሆይ፥ ደስ ይበልሽ ሐሤትም አድርጊ፤ ጽዋው ደግሞ ወደ አንቺ ያልፋል፥ አንቺም ትሰክሪአለሽ ትራቈቻለሽም።

verses.en: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity: he will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.
verses.fr: Fille de Sion, ton iniquité est expiée; Il ne t''enverra plus en captivité. Fille d''Edom, il châtiera ton iniquité, Il mettra tes péchés à découvert.
verses.am: ታው። የጽዮን ልጅ ሆይ፥ የበደልሽ ቅጣት ተፈጸመ፤ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አያስማርክሽም። የኤዶምያስ ልጅ ሆይ፥ በደልሽን ይቀጣል፤ ኃጢአትሽን ይገልጣል።

verses.en: Remember, O Lord, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.
verses.fr: Souviens-toi, Eternel, de ce qui nous est arrivé! Regarde, vois notre opprobre!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የሆነብንን አስብ፤ ተመልከት ስድባችንንም እይ።

verses.en: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.
verses.fr: Notre héritage a passé à des étrangers, Nos maisons à des inconnus.
verses.am: ርስታችን ለእንግዶች፥ ቤቶቻችን ለሌሎች ሆኑ።

verses.en: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.
verses.fr: Nous sommes orphelins, sans père; Nos mères sont comme des veuves.
verses.am: ድሀ አደጎችና አባት የሌለን ሆነናል፤ እናቶቻችን እንደ መበለቶች ሆነዋል።

verses.en: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.
verses.fr: Nous buvons notre eau à prix d''argent, Nous payons notre bois.
verses.am: ውኃችንን በብር ጠጣን እንጨታችንን በዋጋ ገዛን።

verses.en: Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest.
verses.fr: Nous sommes poursuivis, le joug sur le cou; Nous sommes épuisés, nous n''avons point de repos.
verses.am: አሳዳጆቻችን በአንገታችን ላይ ናቸው፤ እኛ ደክመናል ዕረፍትም የለንም።

verses.en: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
verses.fr: Nous avons tendu la main vers l''Egypte, vers l''Assyrie, Pour nous rassasier de pain.
verses.am: ለግብጻውያንና ለአሦራውያን እንጀራ እንጠግብ ዘንድ እጅ ሰጠን።

verses.en: Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.
verses.fr: Nos pères ont péché, ils ne sont plus, Et c''est nous qui portons la peine de leurs iniquités.
verses.am: አባቶቻችን ኃጢአትን ሠሩ ዛሬም የሉም፤ እኛም በደላቸውን ተሸከምን።

verses.en: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.
verses.fr: Des esclaves dominent sur nous, Et personne ne nous délivre de leurs mains.
verses.am: ባሪያዎች ሠልጥነውብናል፤ ከእጃቸው የሚታደገን የለም።

verses.en: We gat our bread with the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.
verses.fr: Nous cherchons notre pain au péril de notre vie, Devant l''épée du désert.
verses.am: ከምድረ በዳ ሰይፍ የተነሣ በሕይወታችን እንጀራችንን እናመጣለን።

verses.en: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.
verses.fr: Notre peau est brûlante comme un four, Par l''ardeur de la faim.
verses.am: ከሚያቃጥል ከራብ ትኩሳት የተነሣ ቁርበታችን እንደ ምድጃ ጠቈረ።

verses.en: They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.
verses.fr: Ils ont déshonoré les femmes dans Sion, Les vierges dans les villes de Juda.
verses.am: በጽዮን ሴቶችን፥ በይሁዳም ከተሞች ደናግልን አጐሰቈሉ።

verses.en: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.
verses.fr: Des chefs ont été pendus par leurs mains; La personne des vieillards n''a pas été respectée.
verses.am: አለቆች በእጃቸው ተሰቀሉ፤ የሽማግሌዎች ፊት አልታፈረም።

verses.en: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.
verses.fr: Les jeunes hommes ont porté la meule, Les enfants chancelaient sous des fardeaux de bois.
verses.am: ጕልማሶች ወፍጮን ተሸከሙ፥ ልጆችም ከእንጨት በታች ተሰናከሉ።

verses.en: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.
verses.fr: Les vieillards ne vont plus à la porte, Les jeunes hommes ont cessé leurs chants.
verses.am: ሽማግሌዎች ከአደባባይ፥ ጕልማሶች ከበገናቸው ተሻሩ።

verses.en: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.
verses.fr: La joie a disparu de nos coeurs, Le deuil a remplacé nos danses.
verses.am: የልባችን ደስታ ቀርቶአል፤ ዘፈናችን ወደ ልቅሶ ተለውጦአል።

verses.en: The crown is fallen from our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned!
verses.fr: La couronne de notre tête est tombée! Malheur à nous, parce que nous avons péché!
verses.am: አክሊል ከራሳችን ወድቆአል፤ ኃጢአት ሠርተናልና ወዮልን!

verses.en: For this our heart is faint; for these things our eyes are dim.
verses.fr: Si notre coeur est souffrant, Si nos yeux sont obscurcis,
verses.am: ስለዚህ ልባችን ታምሞአል፤ ስለዚህም ነገር ዓይናችን ፈዝዞአል፤

verses.en: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.
verses.fr: C''est que la montagne de Sion est ravagée, C''est que les renards s''y promènent.
verses.am: ስለ ጽዮን ተራራ፥ ባድማ ሆናለችና፥ ቀበሮችም ተመላልሰውባታልና።

verses.en: Thou, O Lord, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.
verses.fr: Toi, l''Eternel, tu règnes à jamais; Ton trône subsiste de génération en génération.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ለዘላለም ትኖራለህ፤ ዙፋንህ ከትውልድ እስከ ትውልድ ነው።

verses.en: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, and forsake us so long time?
verses.fr: Pourquoi nous oublierais-tu pour toujours, Nous abandonnerais-tu pour de longues années?
verses.am: ስለ ምን ለዘላለም ትረሳናለህ? ስለ ምንስ ለረጅም ዘመን ትተወናለህ?

verses.en: Turn thou us unto thee, O Lord, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.
verses.fr: Fais-nous revenir vers toi, ô Eternel, et nous reviendrons! Donne-nous encore des jours comme ceux d''autrefois!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ መልሰን እኛም እንመለሳለን፤ ዘመናችንን እንደ ቀድሞ አድስ።

verses.en: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us.
verses.fr: Nous aurais-tu entièrement rejetés, Et t''irriterais-tu contre nous jusqu''à l''excès!
verses.am: ነገር ግን ፈጽመህ ጥለኸናል፤ እጅግ ተቈጥተኸናል።
